name: pech
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Pech is the lowland name for a fairy race. The word came from the old Picts of the north. The pech was a short, strong being, fair of hair and quick at work. They built, ran, and carried stone with ease. They could not bear daylight, and fled home each dawn.

okr.objective: Explain the pech as a fairy race of lowland Scotland.
key_results: The name pech came from the old Picts.
The pech was short, strong, and fair haired.
